ev.q: In 2012, 18 (75%) of the 24 countries with areas of JE virus transmission risk conducted at least some JE surveillance
In 2011, 19 (79%) of the 24 countries reported a total of 10,426 JE cases.
Five (21%) of the 24 countries conducted surveillance nationally or in appropriate geographic risk areas
The 8,247 reported cases from India and 1,625 from China represented 95% of all cases
In 2012, 18 (75%) of the 24 countries with areas of JE virus transmission risk conducted at least some JE surveillance
Surveillance was conducted among all age groups in 16 (89%) of the 18 countries and only in children in two countries.
A review of surveillance and immunization program data in the 24 countries with JE virus transmission risk

methods_quotes.q: Data were obtained from the WHO/United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) Joint Reporting Form (JRF), published literature, meeting reports, and websites.
